verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at dynadot.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes Dynadot as a registrar, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. A documented MCP page adds agent-oriented material. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth or coverage (only a header snippet was captured), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and independent corroboration that agents use these docs effectively.
